longDescription: Media Control for D200 is a macOS-only local companion for Ulanzi D200. It shows generic current-media artwork, title, artist, and progress; provides transport controls; controls macOS output volume and mute; and includes a four-key artwork mosaic. Ulanzi Studio automatically starts the bundled local D200 bridge when needed. Everything runs on the same Mac through a loopback bridge with no cloud service or account. Current-media data uses private macOS MediaRemote APIs. Local v2.1.0 package, Ulanzi Studio, and physical D200 validation succeeded on the tested setup. Signing, notarization, marketplace publication or acceptance, and compatibility across other macOS, Studio, or device versions remain unproven.
